project_info.color_palette: Warm sand beige, coconut green, crisp white, royal blue

main_subject.detail: A clean square social poster shot from a top-down angle on a sunlit sandy textured surface. The main visual anchor is a pair of beige double-buckle slide sandals cropped into the bottom-left corner, paired with a fresh green coconut cropped into the upper-right corner. The composition leaves broad negative space in the center for typography.
main_subject.style: Photorealistic lifestyle flat lay, minimalist fashion advertising, resort editorial styling, clean brand typography

items: Top Left: white sans-serif brand text 'BADASS' placed with generous spacing.
Top Right: a green young coconut cropped by the frame edge, with the top cut open and catching warm sunlight.
Bottom Left: a pair of beige matte slide sandals with two black metal buckles, partially cropped and angled diagonally inward.
Bottom Right: oversized stacked royal-blue sans-serif typography reading 'NEW SHORT FOR SUMMER'.
Center/Background: bright sandy surface with granular texture, subtle footprints and pebbled impressions, hard midday sunlight, and soft organic shadows.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Warm tropical midday light, soft hard-edged shadows, airy resort mood, sun-washed highlights, realistic texture detail

assets.name: BADASS wordmark
assets.usage: Use the exact BADASS brand wordmark as a reference asset so the top-left logo stays brand-accurate in spacing, weight, and letterform.

assets.name: double-buckle slide sandals
assets.source: product reference photo if exact SKU is needed
assets.usage: If the final image must match a real sandal model, pass a reference image of the exact product for silhouette, buckle shape, strap thickness, and material color.

prompt_instructions: If using gpt-image-2, attach the BADASS logo reference and instruct the model to preserve the exact logo design.
If exact product fidelity matters, attach a product reference image for the sandals and ask the model to keep the same shape and hardware.
Do not use a person reference for this creative because no human subject is present.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square advertising poster for a minimal summer fashion launch. Centerpiece is a top-down photorealistic lifestyle flat lay on a sandy textured beach-like surface. Place a pair of beige double-buckle slide sandals cropped in the bottom-left corner, angled diagonally toward the center, and a fresh green coconut cropped in the upper-right corner with the top cut open. Leave broad negative space across the center. Add clean white brand text 'BADASS' in the top left and large stacked royal-blue typography reading 'NEW SHORT FOR SUMMER' in the bottom right. Background is warm sand with fine grain texture, subtle footprints, tiny pebbled marks, and soft sun shadows. Technical style: photorealistic commercial lifestyle photography, natural sunlight, warm tropical midday light, airy resort atmosphere, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
